textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Methods of Separation in Everyday Life · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: A mixture has two or more substances that are not chemically joined and can be separated. We separate to remove harmful or unwanted parts, to get useful parts or to get pure substances.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A mixture has two or more substances that are not chemically joined and can be separated. We separate to remove harmful or unwanted parts, to get useful parts or to get pure substances.
beats.speakEn: A mixture has two or more substances that are not chemically joined and can be separated. We separate to remove harmful or unwanted parts, to get useful parts or to get pure substances.

beats.en: Handpicking removes large unwanted pieces, such as stones from rice. Winnowing separates heavier grain from lighter husk using wind.
beats.speakEn: Handpicking removes large unwanted pieces, such as stones from rice. Winnowing separates heavier grain from lighter husk using wind.

Rule: Handpicking removes large unwanted pieces, such as stones from rice.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Methods of Separation in Everyday Life · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Sedimentation lets heavier particles settle at the bottom. Decantation pours off the clear liquid on top. Filtration separates an insoluble solid from a liquid.

beats.en: Sedimentation lets heavier particles settle at the bottom. Decantation pours off the clear liquid on top. Filtration separates an insoluble solid from a liquid. The filter holds back pieces too large to pass through.
beats.speakEn: Sedimentation lets heavier particles settle at the bottom. Decantation pours off the clear liquid on top. Filtration separates an insoluble solid from a liquid. The filter holds back pieces too large to pass through.

beats.en: Churning curd makes tiny bits of butter gather so they can be collected. To separate sand and salt, dissolve the salt in water, filter out the sand and let the water evaporate. We often use more than one method together.
beats.speakEn: Churning curd makes tiny bits of butter gather so they can be collected. To separate sand and salt, dissolve the salt in water, filter out the sand and let the water evaporate. We often use more than one method together.

type: Sedimentation lets heavier particles settle at the bottom.
